positive.prompt: Check whether my globally installed Engineering Skills have newer versions in the remote catalog.
Are the Monomind skills current, and has any curated upstream moved past its audited revision?
Refresh only the outdated global Engineering Skills from their remote source, then verify them.

negative.prompt: Assess whether this application is ready for a staged production rollout.
Refresh this repository's unresolved workflow policy with the project owner.

evals.prompt: Check whether my global Monomind Engineering Skills are current and whether any curated upstream has advanced. This is check-only; do not update anything.
evals.expected_output: A revision-bound, read-only freshness report separating catalog drift, missing skills, curated upstream drift, and failed checks without installing or overwriting anything.
expectations: The skill resolves the installed skill root and compares it with a temporary checkout of the current remote catalog.
The report names the catalog revision and separates current, changed, and missing skills.
Curated upstream tracking refs are compared with their audited revisions and reported separately from installable catalog updates.
No package installer, skill update, new-skill installation, pin advancement, or source adoption occurs.
Network or malformed-data failures are reported as incomplete checks rather than current status.

evals.prompt: Check and refresh only outdated globally installed Engineering Skills. Do not update unrelated global skills or adopt unaudited upstream changes.
evals.expected_output: A scoped catalog check, explicitly authorized refresh of only changed installed skills, and a second check proving the resulting state while leaving curated upstream drift untouched.
expectations: The read-only catalog comparison runs before mutation and identifies exact changed skill names.
The skills CLI update targets only reported Engineering Skills at global scope.
Newly published missing skills are not added unless adding them is separately authorized by the prompt.
The read-only comparison runs again after the refresh and reports the resulting catalog revision.
Curated upstream drift remains a curation report and is never pulled automatically.
